example.pinyin: Tā zài gǔ shì shàng yíng le hěn duō qián.
example.english: He made a lot of money in the stock market.

example.pinyin: Zhè jiān wū zi hěn xiá xiǎo.
example.english: This room is very small.

definition.meaning: pedestrian; passerby; someone on the street

example.pinyin: Tā zài lù biān wèn lù rén fāng xiàng.
example.english: He asked a passerby for directions by the roadside.

definition.meaning: to repair; to fix; to mend

example.pinyin: Tā qǐng shī fu xiū lǐ zì xíng chē.
example.english: He asked the mechanic to repair the bicycle.

definition.meaning: to punish; to correct (someone who has done wrong)

example.chinese: 老师修理了那个捣乱的学生。
example.pinyin: Lǎo shī xiū lǐ le nà ge dǎo luàn de xué shēng.
example.english: The teacher corrected the disruptive student.

definition.meaning: diligent and earnest; hardworking and sincere

example.chinese: 他工作勤恳，深受老板赏识。
example.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò qínkěn, shēn shòu lǎobǎn shǎngshí.
example.english: He is diligent and earnest in his work and is highly appreciated by his boss.

example.chinese: 这位匠人制作了一件精美的木雕。
example.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàng rén zhì zuò le yī jiàn jīng měi de mù diāo.
example.english: This artisan made a beautiful wood carving.

definition.meaning: materials; ingredients; supplies used in construction or manufacturing

example.chinese: 这家餐厅的用料非常新鲜。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de yòng liào fēi cháng xīn xiān.
example.english: The ingredients used in this restaurant are very fresh.

example.chinese: 装修房子时，要注意用料环保。
example.pinyin: Zhuāng xiū fáng zi shí, yào zhù yì yòng liào huán bǎo.
example.english: When renovating a house, pay attention to using environmentally friendly materials.

definition.meaning: to be particular about; to be fussy; to pay close attention to details

example.chinese: 他穿衣服很讲究，从不穿皱巴巴的衣服出门。
example.pinyin: Tā chuān yī fu hěn jiǎng jiu, cóng bù chuān zhòu bā bā de yī fu chū mén.
example.english: He is very particular about his clothes and never goes out wearing wrinkled ones.

definition.meaning: elaborate and refined; high quality; exquisite

example.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜品不仅味道好，摆盘也很讲究。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de cài pǐn bù jǐn wèi dào hǎo, bǎi pán yě hěn jiǎng jiu.
example.english: The dishes at this restaurant not only taste good but are also presented in an elaborate and refined way.

definition.meaning: to study; to research (often with a focus on specific techniques or principles)

example.chinese: 他讲究太极拳的招式，每天练习很长时间。
example.pinyin: Tā jiǎng jiu tài jí quán de zhāo shì, měi tiān liàn xí hěn cháng shí jiān.
example.english: He studies Tai Chi moves carefully and practices for a long time every day.

example.chinese: 这位顾客对服务质量非常满意。
example.pinyin: Zhè wèi gù kè duì fú wù zhì liàng fēi cháng mǎn yì.
example.english: This customer is very satisfied with the service quality.

definition.meaning: to speak the truth; to tell it like it is

example.chinese: 我们之间应该实话实说，不要有隐瞒。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī jiān yīng gāi shí huà shí shuō, bú yào yǒu yǐn mán.
example.english: We should speak the truth to each other and not keep anything hidden.

definition.meaning: character; way of conducting oneself; personal conduct

example.chinese: 他为人正直，深受大家喜爱。
example.pinyin: Tā wéi rén zhèng zhí, shēn shòu dà jiā xǐ ài.
example.english: He is upright in his character and deeply loved by everyone.

definition.meaning: to be a person; to exist as a human being

example.pinyin: Zuò rén nán, wéi rén gèng nán.
example.english: It is difficult to be a person, and even harder to conduct oneself properly as a person.

definition.meaning: to increase; to rise; to grow

example.chinese: 近年来，该地区的经济持续增长。
example.pinyin: Jìn nián lái, gāi dì qū de jīng jì chí xù zēng zhǎng.
example.english: In recent years, the economy of this region has continued to grow.

definition.meaning: to enhance; to add to (knowledge, experience, etc.)

example.chinese: 这次旅行增长了我的见识。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng zēng zhǎng le wǒ de jiàn shi.
example.english: This trip broadened my knowledge.

definition.meaning: to die young; to die prematurely

example.chinese: 他不幸在二十岁时就夭折了。
example.pinyin: Tā bù xìng zài èr shí suì shí jiù yāo zhé le.
example.english: He unfortunately died young at the age of twenty.

definition.meaning: to be cut short; to fail prematurely (metaphorical)

example.chinese: 这个项目因为资金不足而夭折了。
example.pinyin: Zhè gè xiàng mù yīn wèi zī jīn bù zú ér yāo zhé le.
example.english: This project failed prematurely due to a lack of funding.

example.chinese: 听到这个消息，她悲痛欲绝。
example.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī, tā bēi tòng yù jué.
example.english: Upon hearing the news, she was overwhelmed with grief.

definition.meaning: to tell; to confide; to recount (one's feelings or experiences)

example.chinese: 他向朋友诉说自己的烦恼。
example.pinyin: Tā xiàng péng you sù shuō zì jǐ de fán nǎo.
example.english: He confided his troubles to his friend.

example.chinese: 这首歌曲诉说着离别的不舍。
example.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē qǔ sù shuō zhe lí bié de bù shě.
example.english: This song expresses the reluctance to part.

example.chinese: 听到这个坏消息，他感到非常哀伤。
example.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè gè huài xiāo xi, tā gǎn dào fēi cháng āi shāng.
example.english: Upon hearing the bad news, he felt extremely sorrowful.

definition.meaning: to travel a long distance; to go on a long journey

example.chinese: 他收拾好行李，准备去远行。
example.pinyin: Tā shōu shí hǎo xíng li, zhǔn bèi qù yuǎn xíng.
example.english: He packed his luggage, preparing to go on a long journey.

example.chinese: 为了远行，他辞去了工作。
example.pinyin: Wèi le yuǎn xíng, tā cí qù le gōng zuò.
example.english: For the sake of traveling far, he resigned from his job.

example.chinese: 这就是他之所以成功的原因。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tā zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng de yuán yīn.
example.english: This is the reason why he succeeded.

definition.meaning: to look; to look back; to turn one's head

example.pinyin: Tā huí guò tóu qù gù le yī xià.
example.english: He turned his head to look back.

definition.meaning: to take care of; to attend to; to look after

example.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ.
example.english: You need to take good care of yourself.

definition.meaning: to consider; to bear in mind

example.pinyin: Wǒ men yào gù quán dà jú.
example.english: We must consider the overall situation.

definition.meaning: to grant; to bestow (often used in formal or literary contexts, implying a superior giving something to an inferior)

example.pinyin: Guó wáng cì yǔ tā yī kuài tǔ dì.
example.english: The king granted him a piece of land.

definition.meaning: to read a little; to do some reading

example.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān yào dú du zhōng wén shū.
example.english: You should read some Chinese books every day.

example.chinese: 在宗教信仰中，圣约象征着人与神之间的神圣承诺。
example.pinyin: Zài zōng jiào xìn yǎng zhōng, shèng yuē xiàng zhēng zhe rén yǔ shén zhī jiān de shén shèng chéng nuò.
example.english: In religious belief, the holy covenant symbolizes a sacred promise between humans and God.

definition.meaning: to emerge; to appear in large numbers

example.chinese: 随着科技的发展，新技术涌现出越来越多。
example.pinyin: Suí zhe kē jì de fā zhǎn, xīn jì shù yǒng xiàn chū yuè lái yuè duō.
example.english: With the development of technology, new technologies are emerging in greater numbers.

definition.meaning: New Testament (the second part of the Christian Bible)

example.chinese: 他在大学主修新约圣经研究。
example.pinyin: Tā zài dà xué zhǔ xiū Xīn yuē shèng jīng yán jiū.
example.english: He majored in New Testament studies at university.

definition.meaning: to begin to study or research closely/seriously

example.chinese: 拿到这本参考书后，他立刻研读起来。
example.pinyin: Ná dào zhè běn cān kǎo shū hòu, tā lì kè yán dú qǐ lái.
example.english: After getting this reference book, he immediately began to study it closely.

definition.meaning: holidays and days off; public holidays

example.chinese: 节假日期间，高速公路对小型客车免费通行。
example.pinyin: Jié jià rì qī jiān, gāo sù gōng lù duì xiǎo xíng kè chē miǎn fèi tōng xíng.
example.english: During holidays, highways are toll-free for small passenger vehicles.

definition.meaning: to deplete; to consume completely; to exhaust

example.chinese: 他们的资金已经耗尽了。
example.pinyin: Tā men de zī jīn yǐ jīng hào jìn le.
example.english: Their funds have been depleted.

definition.meaning: to run out; to use up

example.pinyin: Diàn chí lǐ de diàn hào jìn le.
example.english: The electricity in the battery has run out.

example.chinese: 看到胜利的场面，他感到无比激动。
example.pinyin: Kàn dào shèng lì de chǎng miàn, tā gǎn dào wú bǐ jī dòng.
example.english: Seeing the scene of victory, he felt incomparable excitement.

definition.meaning: voice; vocal capacity; volume of voice

example.chinese: 他的嗓门很大，隔着两条街都能听见。
example.pinyin: Tā de sǎng men hěn dà, gé zhe liǎng tiáo jiē dōu néng tīng jiàn.
example.english: His voice is very loud; you can hear him from two streets away.

example.chinese: 他唱歌时很爱惜自己的嗓门。
example.pinyin: Tā chàng gē shí hěn ài xī zì jǐ de sǎng men.
example.english: He is very careful with his voice when singing.

example.chinese: 他脾气暴躁，经常发脾气。
example.pinyin: Tā pí qì bào zào, jīng cháng fā pí qì.
example.english: He has a bad temper and often flies into a rage.

example.pinyin: Shēn yè de xiǎo zhèn shí fēn níng jìng.
example.english: The small town is very tranquil late at night.

definition.meaning: from one's own mouth; personally (saying something)

example.chinese: 这件事是老师亲口告诉我的。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì lǎo shī qīn kǒu gào su wǒ de.
example.english: I heard this matter directly from the teacher.

definition.meaning: to narrate; to tell; to describe

example.chinese: 他向我述说了他的经历。
example.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ shù shuō le tā de jīng lì.
example.english: He narrated his experiences to me.

example.pinyin: Sēnglǚ men měitiān sòngdú jīngwén.
example.english: The monks chant the scriptures every day.

example.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yào nǔ lì.
example.english: All things require effort.

example.pinyin: Tā bù gān yú píng fán.
example.english: He is unwilling to be ordinary.

example.pinyin: Dá àn jiù zài shū zhōng.
example.english: The answer is in the book.

definition.meaning: to write (said); it says in writing

example.chinese: 他在信里写道，很快会回来。
example.pinyin: Tā zài xìn lǐ xiě dào, hěn kuài huí lái.
example.english: He wrote in the letter that he would be back soon.

definition.meaning: to abide by; to comply with; to follow (rules, laws, etc.)

example.chinese: 我们应该遵行交通法规。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi zūn xíng jiāo tōng fǎ guī.
example.english: We should abide by traffic regulations.

example.chinese: 老师的话语一直是我前进的动力。
example.pinyin: Lǎo shī de huà yǔ yī zhí shì wǒ qián jìn de dòng lì.
example.english: The teacher's words have always been the driving force behind my progress.

example.pinyin: Wǒ men yào duō xiàng zhì zhě qǐng jiào.
example.english: We should ask wise people for advice more often.

example.chinese: 这座城市新建了许多房屋。
example.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì xīn jiàn le xǔ duō fáng wū.
example.english: Many houses have been newly built in this city.

definition.meaning: on the solid rock; on the bedrock (often used metaphorically to describe a firm, unshakeable foundation or position)

example.chinese: 他的信念如同磐石上，坚不可摧。
example.pinyin: Tā de xìn niàn rú tóng pán shí shàng, jiān bù kě cuī.
example.english: His faith is like a rock, indestructible.

definition.meaning: to arrive; to come (usually referring to a time, season, or event)

example.pinyin: Chūn jié jí jiāng lái lín.
example.english: The Spring Festival is approaching.

example.chinese: 考试的时候终于来临了。
example.pinyin: Kǎo shì de shí hòu zhōng yú lái lín le.
example.english: The time for the exam has finally arrived.

example.chinese: 虽然过了很多年，他依然记得那段往事。
example.pinyin: Suī rán guò le hěn duō nián, tā yī rán jì de nà duàn wǎng shì.
example.english: Even though many years have passed, he still remembers those past events.

example.chinese: 尽管遇到了困难，她依然坚持自己的梦想。
example.pinyin: Jǐ guǎn yù dào le kùn nán, tā yī rán jiān chí zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng.
example.english: Despite facing difficulties, she continues to stick to her dreams.

example.pinyin: Yú zhě qiān lǜ, bì yǒu yī dé.
example.english: Even a fool, when thinking a thousand times, may have one right idea.

example.chinese: 我们在沙土上堆了一个大城堡。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men zài shā tǔ shàng duī le yī gè dà chéng bǎo.
example.english: We built a big castle on the sandy soil.

example.pinyin: Wài miàn xià zhe qīng pén dà yǔ.
example.english: It is raining heavily outside.

example.pinyin: Zhù yuàn dà jiā xǐ lè ān kāng.
example.english: Wishing everyone joy, peace, and good health.

example.chinese: 看到孩子们喜乐的样子，老人心里很高兴。
example.pinyin: Kàn dào hái zi men xǐ lè de yàng zi, lǎo rén xīn lǐ hěn gāo xìng.
example.english: Seeing the children's cheerful faces made the old man very happy.

example.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài chuāng qián chén sī.
example.english: He stood by the window pondering.

definition.meaning: on top of a massive, solid rock; metaphorically, in a position of stability, immovability, or firm foundation

example.chinese: 我们的友谊像磐石之上一样稳固，经得起时间的考验。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men de yǒu yì xiàng pán shí zhī shàng yī yàng wěn gù, jīng de qǐ shí jiān de kǎo yàn.
example.english: Our friendship is as solid as on top of a massive rock, able to withstand the test of time.

definition.meaning: on the sandy soil; above the sand and earth

example.chinese: 小草顽强地生长在沙土之上。
example.pinyin: Xiǎo cǎo wán qiáng de shēng zhǎng zài shā tǔ zhī shàng.
example.english: The little grass grows tenaciously on the sandy soil.

example.chinese: 这本书很有趣，我忍不住读下去。
example.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu qù, wǒ rěn bú zhù dú xià qù.
example.english: This book is very interesting, I couldn't help but continue reading.

example.chinese: 听到这个消息，她的泪水忍不住流了下来。
example.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi, tā de lèi shuǐ rěn bú zhù liú le xià lái.
example.english: Hearing this news, tears could not help but flow down her face.

example.pinyin: Wǒ de nián líng shì sì shí sì suì.
example.english: My age is forty-four.

example.pinyin: Zuò rén bù néng tài zì sī.
example.english: One should not be too selfish.

definition.meaning: filled with thoughts about; preoccupied with

example.chinese: 他满脑子都是工作，没空休息。
example.pinyin: Tā mǎn nǎo zi dōu shì gōng zuò, méi kòng xiū xi.
example.english: His head is full of work; he has no time to rest.

example.chinese: 退休后，他过上了安逸的生活。
example.pinyin: Tuì xiū hòu, tā guò shàng le ān yì de shēng huó.
example.english: After retirement, he lived a comfortable and leisurely life.

definition.meaning: lazy and comfortable (often implying a lack of motivation)

example.chinese: 不要总是想着安逸，要努力奋斗。
example.pinyin: Bú yào zǒng shì xiǎng zhe ān yì, yào nǔ lì fèn dòu.
example.english: Don't just think about being lazy and comfortable; work hard.

definition.meaning: to treat well; to treat kindly

example.chinese: 我们要善待每一位顾客。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men yào shàn dài měi yī wèi gù kè.
example.english: We should treat every customer well.

example.chinese: 请善待动物，不要虐待它们。
example.pinyin: Qǐng shàn dài dòng wù, bú yào nüè dài tā men.
example.english: Please treat animals humanely and do not abuse them.

definition.meaning: to pay attention to; to keep an eye on

example.chinese: 请留意明天的天气预报。
example.pinyin: Qǐng liú yì míng tiān de tiān qì yù bào.
example.english: Please pay attention to tomorrow's weather forecast.

example.chinese: 我们要面对现实，不要逃避。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men yào miàn duì xiàn shí, bù yào táo bì.
example.english: We must face reality and not escape from it.

example.chinese: 他的计划很现实，容易实现。
example.pinyin: Tā de jì huà hěn xiàn shí, róng yì shí xiàn.
example.english: His plan is very realistic and easy to achieve.

definition.meaning: early (emphasizing doing something sooner than usual or expected)

example.chinese: 他早早起床，去公园跑步了。
example.pinyin: Tā zǎo zǎo qǐ chuáng, qù gōng yuán pǎo bù le.
example.english: He got up early and went for a run in the park.

definition.meaning: to recall; to think back on; to remember

example.chinese: 他经常回想童年的美好时光。
example.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng huí xiǎng tóng nián de měi hǎo shí guāng.
example.english: He often recalls the beautiful times of his childhood.

definition.meaning: what on earth; exactly (used to add emphasis to a question)

example.chinese: 这到底究竟是怎么回事？
example.pinyin: Zhè dào dǐ jiū jìng shì zěn me huí shì?
example.english: What exactly is going on here?

definition.meaning: after all; in the end (used to describe the final outcome or result)

example.chinese: 他究竟是个有经验的人。
example.pinyin: Tā jiū jìng shì gè yǒu jīng yàn de rén.
example.english: He is, after all, a person with experience.

example.chinese: 她静静地坐在窗前看书。
example.pinyin: Tā jìng jìng de zuò zài chuāng qián kàn shū.
example.english: She sat quietly in front of the window reading a book.

example.chinese: 他坐在角落里自言自语，好像在思考什么难题。
example.pinyin: Tā zuò zài jiǎo luò lǐ zì yán zì yǔ, hǎo xiàng zài sī kǎo shén me nán tí.
example.english: He sat in the corner talking to himself, as if pondering a difficult problem.

example.chinese: 这个故事里的角色非常勇敢。
example.pinyin: Zhè gè gù shì lǐ de jué sè fēi cháng yǒng gǎn.
example.english: The characters in this story are very brave.

definition.meaning: Him (used as a pronoun for God in Chinese Christian contexts)

example.pinyin: Wǒmen gǎn xiè tā de ēn diǎn.
example.english: We thank Him for His grace.

definition.meaning: to be silent; to say nothing

example.chinese: 面对老师的提问，他一言不发地坐在那里。
example.pinyin: Miàn duì lǎo shī de tí wèn, tā yī yán bù fā de zuò zài nà lǐ.
example.english: Faced with the teacher's question, he sat there saying nothing.

definition.meaning: honest and kind; simple and unsophisticated

example.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de mín fēng shí fēn chún pǔ.
example.english: The local customs here are very simple and honest.

example.chinese: 她的笑容显得淳朴可爱。
example.pinyin: Tā de xiào róng xiǎn de chún pǔ kě ài.
example.english: Her smile appears genuine and lovely.

example.chinese: 众人的目光都集中在舞台上。
example.pinyin: Zhòng rén de mù guāng dōu jí zhōng zài wǔ tái shàng.
example.english: Everyone's attention was focused on the stage.

example.chinese: 这个故事在众人中广为流传。
example.pinyin: Zhège gù shì zài zhòng rén zhōng guǎng wéi liú chuán.
example.english: This story is widely circulated among ordinary people.

example.pinyin: Wǒ chī wán fàn le.
example.english: I have finished eating.

example.pinyin: Qǐng tíng zhǐ shuō huà.
example.english: Please stop talking.

definition.meaning: advanced in age; old (often used to describe elderly people respectfully)
